<a id="page-layout"></a>
# Layout

Sizes, rows, columns, stacks, flex and scrolling: every layout key and the layout words. Open it when a size, a
place or a scroll is more than `w`, `h`, `gap`, `pad`, `grow` and the alignment words.

<a id="layout-sizes"></a>
## Sizes

`w` and `h` take a number (fixed), `fill` or `hug`. A size that keeps its design size is its JSON
(`w={"fill":390}`): a printed document writes it so. `grow` shares the room left in a Row or Column; `basis=320` on
a child of a wrapping Row is the width it starts from.

```notation
Column gap=8
  Text "Fixed" w=120
  Row gap=8
    Column w=40 h=40 fill=#FFE5E7EB
    Column h=40 grow fill=#FFDBEAFE
    Column h=40 grow fill=#FFBFDBFE
```

`maxWidth=720` keeps a column from stretching; `minWidth`, `minHeight`, `maxHeight` likewise (`minWidth`, `maxWidth`, `minHeight`, `maxHeight` are
the bounds of `constraints`).

```notation
Column maxWidth=720
  Text "Capped"
```

<a id="layout-place"></a>
## Place

In a Stack a child sits where `x` and `y` put it (a number from the start, or `{"end":8}`, `{"align":0}`), or
where `align` puts it.

```notation
Stack w=200 h=120
  Text "Corner" x=8 y=8
  Text "Center" align=center
```

A Row wraps with `wrap=true` (`runSpacing` between its lines). `sticky` keeps a line in view while the page scrolls
under it.

```notation
Row gap=8 wrap=true runSpacing=8
  Text "One"
  Text "Two"
```

<a id="layout-scrolling"></a>
## Scrolling

`scroll` on a Column scrolls what is under it; on a Row, sideways. `scrollTo node=faq` and the `scroll` verb move
a scroll view to a line; `onScroll={…}` reads `result.fraction` (see [events.md](events.md)).

```notation
Column scroll h=300
  Text "Tall"
```

<a id="layout-keys-every-line-takes"></a>
## Keys every line takes

Layout keys are on every line. The short words: `w`, `h`, `pad`, `grow`; the others by their own name.

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `w` (or `width`) | [AxisSize](values.md#type-AxisSize) | `0` | 0 | The node's width: a number (fixed), `{"hug": n}` (its content), `{"fill": n}` (the room its parent gives) or `{"flexible": n}` (up to n). n is the design size. Without one the node is 0 wide. |
| `h` (or `height`) | [AxisSize](values.md#type-AxisSize) | `0` | 0 | The node's height: a number (fixed), `{"hug": n}`, `{"fill": n}` or `{"flexible": n}`, as `width`. Without one the node is 0 high. |
| `constraints` | [BoxConstraints](values.md#type-BoxConstraints) | `{}` | 0 |  |
| `margin` | [EdgeInsets](values.md#type-EdgeInsets) | `0` | 0 | Space around the node, outside its box. |
| `pad` (or `padding`) | [EdgeInsets](values.md#type-EdgeInsets) | `0` | 0 | Space between the node's box and its content (Flutter's `Padding`). A text's padding sits around its lines, as `Padding(child: Text(...))`: a hugging text grows by it (schema 3; schema 2 ignored it on a text, and the migration drops it there). |
| `aspectRatio` | number (≥ 0) |  | 0 | Width / height the node keeps when its parent resizes it. |
| `grow` (or `flex`) | whole number (≥ 0) | `1` | 0 | Under a row/column: share of the free space (`Expanded.flex`). |
| `squeezable` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Under a row/column: a hugging child that may shrink (`Flexible`). |
| `x` | [AxisPosition](values.md#type-AxisPosition) | `{"start":0}` | 0 | Under a freeform parent (`Positioned` / `Align`). |
| `y` | [AxisPosition](values.md#type-AxisPosition) | `{"start":0}` | 0 | Position under a freeform parent. |
| `align` | [Alignment](values.md#type-Alignment) |  | 0 | Under a row/column: alignment in its slot (`Align`). |
| `order` | whole number | `0` | 0 | CSS `order`: under a row, column or flex, children are laid out and painted by ascending order (equal orders as listed). Patch it per screen size (`media`) to reorder at a width. |
| `basis` | number (≥ 0) |  | 0 | CSS `flex-basis`, under a wrapping row, column or flex: the main size the child counts when lines are broken; a child that fills the main axis (`{"fill": n}`) then grows by its `flex` share of the room left on its line (`flex: 1 1 280px`). Cards with `basis: 280` sit three across at 900 px, two at 600, one at 390, with no breakpoints. |
| `columnSpan` | whole number (≥ 1) | `1` | 0 | CSS `grid-column: span n`, under a gridView: how many columns the item covers (at most the grid's columns). Bind it per item (`${= index == 0 ? 2 : 1}`: a lead story across two) and patch it per screen size (`media`). |
| `rowSpan` | whole number (≥ 1) | `1` | 0 | CSS `grid-row: span n`, under a gridView: how many rows the item covers. |
| `columnStart` | whole number |  | 0 | CSS `grid-column-start`, under a gridView: the column the item starts in, 1 the first; unset: the next free cell. With `rowStart`, a timetable puts each session at its track and time. |
| `rowStart` | whole number |  | 0 | CSS `grid-row-start`, under a gridView: the row the item starts in, 1 the first; unset: the next free cell. |

<a id="layout-words"></a>
## Words

<a id="node-canvas"></a>
### `canvas` (`canvas`)

Flutter `Scaffold`.

- Written `canvas`. Level 0 (Core).
- Takes no quoted string.
- Its children are slots: `body`, `appBar`, `floatingActionButton`, `bottomNavigationBar`.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): yes.

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scaleMode` | `responsive` `autoScale` | `responsive` | 0 | How the canvas fits a screen of another size than its design size: lays out at the screen's size, or scales the design. |
| `blockBack` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | While true, going back (the system or browser back button, a back gesture) keeps the user on this screen and runs its `backPressed` reactions instead. Usually bound (`${= dirty}`). A navigate pop from the screen's own actions is never blocked. |
| `breakpoint` | text | `""` | 0 | The breakpoint it is the design for. |
| `screen` | text | `""` | 0 | The screen it is a breakpoint of. |
| `breakpointMinWidth` | number (≥ 0) |  | 0 | Its own switch point. |
| `overlay` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Shown above every screen, outside navigation. |
| `backdrop` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Drawn beneath every screen, outside navigation. |
| `semanticLabel` | text | `""` | 0 | Its name for assistive technology when it opens as an overlay (a dialog, a sheet, a menu). Empty: its first text, or for a menu the label of the control that opened it. |

<a id="node-row"></a>
### `Row` (`row`)

Flutter `Row`.

- Written `Row`; also `Badge`. Level 0 (Core).
- `Row "…"` sets `a node under it (`text`, `props.text`)`; a second string sets `a node under it (`text`, `props.text`)`.
- The lines under it are its children.
- Decoration keys (`fill`, `border`, `radius`, `effects`…): yes.

| Key | Type | Default | Level | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mainAxisAlignment` | `start` `end` `center` `spaceBetween` `spaceAround` `spaceEvenly` | `start` | 0 | How the children are placed along the main axis (horizontal in a row, vertical in a column), Flutter's `MainAxisAlignment`: `start`, `end`, `center`, `spaceBetween`, `spaceAround`, `spaceEvenly`. |
| `crossAxisAlignment` | `start` `end` `center` `stretch` `baseline` | `center` | 0 | How the children are placed across the main axis, Flutter's `CrossAxisAlignment`. The default `center` centers them: write `start` for left-aligned (or top-aligned) content, `stretch` to make every child as wide (or tall) as the node. A row places its children by their control boxes, as a web page lines up form controls: a field's label hangs above the line and its helper or error below it, so a button, a text or an icon beside the field is centered on (`start`: level with the top of, `end`: the foot of, `stretch`: as tall as) the field's box, with nothing to write. A column of a label text, one field and captions under it lines up the same way. |
| `gap` (or `spacing`) | number (≥ 0) | `0` | 0 | Space between children along the main axis. |
| `wrap` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Wraps children onto new runs when they overflow (`Wrap`). |
| `runSpacing` | number (≥ 0) | `0` | 0 | Space between runs when wrapping. |
| `squeezeChildren` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 0 | Children that overflow a bounded main axis shrink to fit it (by how far each can, never below its content), as the editor lays them out; false lays them out at their own sizes and lets them run past the end, as Flutter's `Row`/`Column` does. |
| `scrollable` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Scrolls its content. |
| `scrollDirection` | `horizontal` `vertical` | `vertical` | 0 | The axis it scrolls along. |
| `reverse` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 |  |
| `physics` | `platform` `bouncing` `clamping` `never` `rangeMaintaining` | `platform` | 0 |  |
| `alwaysScroll` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Scrolls even when the content fits. |
| `clipBehavior` | `none` `hardEdge` `antiAlias` `antiAliasWithSaveLayer` | `hardEdge` | 0 |  |
| `itemSnapping` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | Each drag or fling comes to rest with an item at the start of the view (CSS `scroll-snap-type: mandatory` with `scroll-snap-align: start`), as PageView.pageSnapping does for pages: a carousel of cards. |
| `edgeFade` | number (≥ 0) | `0` | 0 | Content that continues past an edge fades out over this many pixels there, not cut hard: a strip of cards inside a padded card. |
| `dragEdgeScroll` | `true`/`false` | `true` | 0 | Scrolls while a dragged node is held near its edges; off: stays put under a drag (a strip of tabs a card is dragged onto). |
| `fillViewport` | `true`/`false` | `false` | 0 | A scrolling row/column's content is at least as long as its viewport (`ConstrainedBox(minHeight: viewport)` in a `SingleChildScrollView`): alignment and expanded children use the whole viewport while it fits. Already so when it centers or spreads its children or has a flex child; this makes it so in every case. |

<a id="layout-behaviors"></a>
## Keys any line takes here

<a id="behavior-sticky"></a>
### `sticky` (behavior)

Pinned in its scrolling view while its parent is in view.

Written `sticky={…}` on any line ([Sticky](#type-Sticky)). Level 4.
 Each field of its record (Sticky) is a key of its own, dotted: `sticky.offset=…`.

<a id="type-Sticky"></a>
| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sticky.offset` | number | `0` | Distance from the view's leading edge where it pins (px). |

<a id="behavior-floating"></a>
### `floating` (behavior)

Drawn above everything else at runtime (a menu under a field), still taking its place in the layout. The design canvas draws it in place.

Written `floating=…` on any line (`true`/`false`, default `false`). Level 4.

<a id="behavior-measure"></a>
### `measure` (behavior)

Its laid-out box, written to a variable.

Written `measure={…}` on any line ([Measure](#type-Measure)). Level 4.
 Each field of its record (Measure) is a key of its own, dotted: `measure.variable=…`.

<a id="type-Measure"></a>
| Key | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `measure.variable` | text | `""` | The variable its box is written to. |
| `measure.key` | text | `""` | The key it's written under, for a map variable. |
| `measure.relativeTo` | text | `""` | An ancestor node whose box it's measured in; empty: the screen. |

<a id="layout-events-and-actions"></a>
## Events and actions

Each is on [events.md](events.md), with its fields.

- Events: [`onScroll`](events.md#trigger-scroll), [`onScrollEnd`](events.md#trigger-scrollEnd), [`onEnterViewport`](events.md#trigger-enterViewport), [`onExitViewport`](events.md#trigger-exitViewport).
- Actions: [`scrollTo`](events.md#action-scrollTo).

<a id="layout-examples"></a>
## Examples

The JSON reference's examples for this page, printed in the notation. A `{…}` at the end of a line is what the notation has no words for yet ([_tails.md](_tails.md)).

<a id="layout-example-sizing-json"></a>
### sizing.json

From [`sizing.json`](../layout.md).

```notation width=400
canvas h=400
Column#col gap=8 pad=10 w={"fill":400} h={"fill":400}
  Text#hugText "As wide as its text" size=16 color=#FF000000 w={"hug":80} h={"hug":20}
  box#fillBox w={"fill":380} h=24 fill=#FFEF4444
  Row#bar gap=10 w={"fill":380} h=40 crossAxisAlignment=null
    box#one w={"fill":100} h={"fill":40} fill=#FF22C55E
    box#two w={"fill":200} h={"fill":40} grow=2 fill=#FF3B82F6
    box#fixed w=60 h=20 fill=#FF9CA3AF
```

<a id="layout-example-responsive-web-json"></a>
### responsive_web.json

From [`responsive_web.json`](../layout.md).

```notation width=1440
state plans=[{"name":"Starter","price":"$0"},{"name":"Team","price":"$29"},{"name":"Enterprise","price":"Talk to us"}]
canvas h=900
Column#page scroll w={"fill":1440} h={"fill":900} crossAxisAlignment=null
  Row#header between pad=[16,0,16,0] w={"fill":1440} h=64 fill=#FF111827 crossAxisAlignment=null minDesktop.pad=[32,0,32,0]
    Text.title#logo "Relay" weight=700 color=#FFFFFFFF w={"hug":80} h={"hug":24}
    Row#nav gap=32 w={"hug":300} h={"hug":20} hidden crossAxisAlignment=null minDesktop.visible=true
```
